title: Habitable Zone
survival_class: Safe and Secure. (header list: 'Safe and Secure', 'Presence of Anomalous Resources', third item unresolved template)
physical_identity: Endless non-Euclidean halls like a cross between an underground parking lot and an abandoned warehouse (grey concrete, pillars, pipes), plus a labyrinth of dim concrete corridors with purposeless rooms.
scale_topology: Huge indoor level, partitioned into sectors (Aquila, Gild, Gothic, Ouroboros, Garden, Fabled); halls non-Euclidean, corridors Euclidean for kilometres.
anomalies: crates appear behind your back and disappear when unobserved
locks and paintings vanish when looked at
Garden Sector transforms people into plants in about an hour
lighting_sound: Artificial overhead lights with random total-blackout Flickering; pipes clang and rumble; corridors dim and quiet. No sun; time not meaningful (narrative).

signature_mechanic: Non-Euclidean hall of crates and pillars with random total-blackout Flickering; retreat to Euclidean corridor rooms; landmark navigation; crates that vanish when unobserved; sector variants.
verticality: Mostly flat; a few sourced vertical links (ceiling holes to Level 19, stairs/elevator from Level 141).
do_not: let flashlights work in the halls during Flickering
treat narrative first-person story as article fact
conflicts_notes: Page mixes factual guide sections with first-person fiction (nameless wanderer; Stephanie Ashford). Footnote bodies, the sector carousel and entity-table photos are not captured. The Fabled Sector excerpt by Leo Castellos is cut off mid-sentence. 'Only entrance you know of is Level 0' vs a long entrance list. The 'level 15' after the bHZsMzUy line is a footnote marker; link target is /level-352.
